profile.description: Host-scoped all-on Arm v2 policy for AWS c8g.8xlarge / Graviton4 32-vCPU Neoverse-V2. It covers the OSS 0.6B and 1.7B models; preferred concurrency remains unqualified until this host's quality and soak gates are recorded.

objective.preferred_concurrency_evidence: 30-minute closed-loop soaks, strict KPI, this profile as committed, 2026-09-15. 0.6B C12: 3962 completed, 0 errors/rejects/timeouts, STREAM RTF p95 0.836, TTFA p95 198 ms, safe-play-start p95 356 ms, stall@250/@500 0%/0%. 1.7B C10: 3665 completed, 0/0/0, STREAM RTF p95 0.831, TTFA p95 207 ms, safe-play-start p95 364 ms, stall@250/@500 0%/0%. Latency, per-class (5 classes) and resource-stability KPI PASS on both; threads flat at 92. Knee screens put the breakdown at 0.6B C13 and the end of stall-free operation at 1.7B C11. These points assume a client prebuffer of at least 250 ms: stall@100 is 22-23% at these densities.

quality_gate.command: strict profile preflight + same-model serving-generation structural/audio gate
quality_gate.audio_gate: same OSS model, voice, language, seed/settings and bank; valid non-empty PCM/WAV plus playback checks

parity.notes: Host-scoped AWS c8g.8xlarge/Graviton4 32-vCPU policy. KAI, RES1_V2, BF16 pre-up and the elastic lane split are explicitly active for the OSS qualification campaign; the 2-slot multislot cohort is RETIRED on this host (VALID FALLBACK, see QWEN_SD_MULTISLOT) after it measured 1.63x the cost of sequential singleton decode; the host-specific audio and soak gates have now passed and this file promotes 0.6B C12 / 1.7B C10 (see objective.preferred_concurrency_evidence); those points assume a client prebuffer of at least 250 ms.

hardware.smt_policy: OFF; one thread per physical core
hardware.notes: AWS c8g.8xlarge/Graviton4 32-vCPU host, no SMT and one NUMA node. The GEMV shape discriminator retained 4x8 scaling on this Neoverse-V2 control; server quality/capacity remain unqualified until the host-specific gates pass.

server.worker_affinity: contiguous core slices, worker 0 -> CPU 0-7, worker 1 -> CPU 8-15, worker 2 -> CPU 16-23, worker 3 -> CPU 24-31

precision.activations: KAI native preparation; INT8 RES1_V2 decoder panels

QWEN_ARM_BFDOT.why: keep the measured/default KAI BF16 policy explicit; BFDOT is a separate opt-in

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: keep the external BLAS pool from spinning against the engine pool

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: must be absent so engine-owned BLAS sizing is effective

OMP_NUM_THREADS.why: must be absent; the engine profile owns the CPU budget

QWEN_CP_PREFILL2.why: pin the explicit Arm CP prefill policy

QWEN_DECODER_BATCH.why: keep server batching semantics; preflight verifies per-item decoder leaf

QWEN_SD_BF16_PREUP.why: host-scoped all-on 0.6B policy; KAI BF16 prepared-state path is enabled

QWEN_INT8_SDOT_MM.why: do not opt into the separate generic SDOT matmat gate

QWEN_INT8_SDOT_MIN_B.why: pin the Arm SDOT matmat gate even though the product decoder is per-item

QWEN_BFMMLA_MIN_B.why: pin the Arm BF16 matrix gate

QWEN_KAI_LHS.why: pin the existing asymmetric KAI LHS quantisation mode

QWEN_KAI_NCHUNK.why: pin the measured KAI GEMM n-subtiling policy

QWEN_NO_BFMMLA.why: allow native Arm BF16 matrix path

QWEN_NO_KLEIDI.why: KleidiAI is the Arm product backend

QWEN_NO_Q8REPACK.why: retain the native Arm Q8 repack path

QWEN_NO_SDOT.why: require the Arm DOTPROD decoder leaf

QWEN_POOL_SPIN.why: Arm-specific starting policy; must be requalified on the target host

QWEN_PREFIX_CACHE.why: same server semantics as the AMX lane

QWEN_SD_AMX.why: x86-only legacy switch; must be absent on Arm

QWEN_SD_INT8.why: select the measured Arm INT8 RES1_V2 decoder

QWEN_SD_INT8_BLK.why: pin the existing non-VNNI decoder block policy

QWEN_SD_LANE_ELASTIC.why: host-scoped 4x8 Neoverse-V2 lane policy; must be confirmed by the serving check

QWEN_SD_LANE_SPLIT.why: host-scoped Arm decoder lane split for the 4x8 candidate; must be confirmed by the serving check

QWEN_SD_MULTISLOT.why: RETIRED on this host 2026-09-14: the ragged cohort is a measured per-call loss on the Arm int8 path. Isolated decode_quantum_bench on this box (chunk 4, taskset 0-7, 8 threads): 1 singleton 40.6 ms, 2 sequential singletons 81.0 ms, 1 ragged pair 132.1 ms (1.63x), and the same ~1.6x at chunk 1/2/8 and at S=3. Cost map puts 100% of the excess in conv_stack; QWEN_SD_PHASE puts +42.5 ms in res1 and +7.1 ms in res2 (the two multi-kernel call sites) while the shared f32 ConvT is 0.7 ms cheaper; objdump shows sd_dconv_multi_worker spilling its runtime-indexed accumulators (40 q-stores / 33 q-loads around 30 sdot) where the single-slot kernel has none. Weight sizes and measured bandwidth bound the sharing upside at a few ms per pair. The pre-registered COHORT_MAX_B=2 vs =1 A/B at C8 and C10 did not meet its keep rule. Per-item int8 DOTPROD is the qualified decoder leaf here.
QWEN_SD_MULTISLOT.revert: QWEN_SD_MULTISLOT=2 only after an exact S==2 named-accumulator kernel lands and beats sequential singleton decode in decode_quantum_bench; the flag, kernel and multi-slot self-test cases stay in the tree

QWEN_SD_RES1_V2.why: select the verified rectangular/wide Arm DOTPROD decoder leaf

QWEN_SD_RAG_MIN_PANELS.why: same logical threshold; no Arm ragged decoder implementation is implied

QWEN_SD_STREAM_STRIP.why: Design-D warm strip unavailable on Arm

QWEN_SD_WINDOWED.why: explicitly disable the legacy windowed fallback so the exact streaming decoder semantics are resolved

QWEN_SERVER_NO_DECODER_BATCH.why: presence flag must remain absent; decoder request is explicit

QWEN_TTS_STREAM_LAYOUT.why: same official known-text serving layout as AMX; ICL/clone and live incremental text remain outside this lane

qualification.workload: Host-scoped OSS 0.6B and 1.7B all-on qualification on AWS c8g.8xlarge/Graviton4 32-vCPU, with 4x8 as the post-discriminator candidate baseline. Capacity recommendations are produced only from this host's WAVE, Poisson, playback and soak evidence.
qualification.speaker: ryan
qualification.notes: Host-scoped Graviton4 profile only. It does not change arm-product defaults and must remain unqualified until all-on structural/audio quality, playback, and sustained-load gates are recorded. The run manifest, not this static profile, is the source of measured commit and binary provenance.
